lines.text: The Coral Express slows on the black-sand beach. There is no platform here, only the hush of the waves.
The rails run down the sand and into the sea. The train follows them, and the water closes softly over the roof.
The glass swings open. Every fish swims out to meet its wild cousins.
And one by one, they swim back to the carriages, because the train is home too.

endlessToast: The Undersea Line is open. Fares ×2, forever.
